title: Approve operations definition
decision: Adopt the operations definition in docs/10-operations/OUTPUT.md: test strategy, manual gated releases, monitoring and alerting, daily encrypted backups with recovery targets of 4 hours and 24 hours, single-operator incident handling, and eleven production launch criteria. This is not a production launch approval.
context: The pipeline ends before the build begins; none of the launch criteria is met and compliance readiness depends on a legal review that has not happened
chosen_option: Operations definition as written; launch approval withheld until criteria are met
rationale: Defines every operational area the stage contract lists at a scale one operator can run, and makes the unmet launch criteria explicit instead of implying readiness
